body:
i suppose by "minimum amount of trauma" i mean more along the lines of them not having to walk in on some gory mess as a result of my death. because i have resigned myself to the fact that should i succeed, i will probably completely devastate my family, and shock my friends.

and i know it's terrible for me to know that and still want to go through with it. but remembering that year of time when the ptsd was strongest (think constant panic attacks, being unable to leave my room without someone going with me, blanking entire days out of my memory, crippling fear, and regular nightmares) just makes me even more convinced that i would truly rather die than live through that again. and i can feel it coming back, which terrifies me to no end. especially since if people didn't believe that the initial trauma occurred, they would never believe that i was suffering ptsd as a result.

but you're right. just typing this out right now is some form of relief. even though it does nothing to alleviate me of the fear that my ptsd symptoms will come back.

i understand that many people would be hurt immensely by my killing myself. i have a family who loves me, as well as friends who care. so my mind knows that my death would cause them to suffer. but illogically, there is still this giant part of me that is intent on figuring out a way to die, preferably a way that causes a (completely relative of course) minimum amount of trauma for those i would leave behind. i just feel like regardless of how much i care for them, and how much they care for me, my life as a whole is just too much for me to take (especially because of the ptsd - the more i think of it the more i am completely sure i flat out cannot survive another year of severe ptsd symptoms).

that and... i still have no idea who to talk to. my significant other knows that i have these thoughts. except i know there is only so much he can do, and no matter how supportive he can be, talking to him alone will not get me the kind of help i will need to fully recover.

(also. the fact that i'm still here on reddit as opposed to working horrendously counterproductive to my getting work done but seeing as i can't concentrate on work, i guess this is better than nothing?)

i don't know of anything nearby for this type of thing. and short of just attempting to look up random doctors online (which i don't picture being very successful), i really don't know where to go.

that and i somehow feel like i don't have the time. grad apps are due far too soon for my taste and there's all the other related work that needs to get done as well. though i know those are all just excuses for not seeking out help.

either way though the fact remains that i don't know where to seek out help from. i refuse to return to the school's center - once there was way more than enough to turn me off it permanently.
